entities.name: Oozes
entities.description: Unintelligent amorphous slime that consume whatever is in their path; found on many planes.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: Plane where oozes are iconic and found in every biome.

entities.name: Ley mages
entities.description: Muragandans who assume oozes are a planar antibody.

entities.name: Scar witches
entities.description: Muragandans who say oozes are moon-ruin entities.

entities.name: Saurids
entities.description: Muragandans who say oozes are the living essence of their ancestors.

entities.name: Telu-Set
entities.description: Muragandans who see oozes as horrors and nightmares.

entities.name: Fang Druids
entities.description: Muragandans who see oozes as walking cultivar engines.
